## Summary

What changed, and which issue does it address?

## Verification

List the exact checks you ran and their results. If a check was not run, say
why. For runtime changes, describe the observed natural event and exact build
identity; a smoke run only demonstrates startup and frame presentation.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] The change follows `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] No XBE, generated game C, retail instruction bytes, extracted assets or
      filenames, saves, BIOS data, private paths, or run evidence are included.
- [ ] Third-party material and its license are identified, if applicable.
